import MumfordLib.SingularSmallChains

/-!
# Two-set API for small singular chains

The circle calculation uses a two-member open cover repeatedly.  This file
packages the corresponding specialization of `smallSingularSubcomplex` so
that later subdivision and cochain comparison arguments can use an explicit
union without unfolding a Boolean-indexed family.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Opposite
open scoped Simplicial

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable (X : TopCat)

/-- A two-member small singular subcomplex is the union of the two members. -/
theorem smallSingularSubcomplex_two (U V : Set X) :
    smallSingularSubcomplex X (fun b : Bool => if b then U else V) =
      singularSubset X U ⊔ singularSubset X V := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro n σ hσ
    rw [mem_smallSingularSubcomplex_iff] at hσ
    rcases hσ with ⟨b, hb⟩
    cases b with
    | false =>
        exact Or.inr ((mem_singularSubset_iff X V n σ).2 hb)
    | true =>
        exact Or.inl ((mem_singularSubset_iff X U n σ).2 hb)
  · intro n σ hσ
    rcases hσ with hσ | hσ
    · rw [mem_smallSingularSubcomplex_iff]
      exact ⟨true, (mem_singularSubset_iff X U n σ).1 hσ⟩
    · rw [mem_smallSingularSubcomplex_iff]
      exact ⟨false, (mem_singularSubset_iff X V n σ).1 hσ⟩

@[simp]
theorem mem_smallSingularSubcomplex_two_iff (U V : Set X)
    (n : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ) (σ : (TopCat.toSSet.obj X).obj n) :
    σ ∈ (smallSingularSubcomplex X (fun b : Bool => if b then U else V)).obj n ↔
      (∀ t, X.toSSetObjEquiv n σ t ∈ U) ∨
      (∀ t, X.toSSetObjEquiv n σ t ∈ V) := by
  rw [mem_smallSingularSubcomplex_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
    cases b with
    | false => exact Or.inr hb
    | true => exact Or.inl hb
  · intro h
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact ⟨true, h⟩
    · exact ⟨false, h⟩

end Mumford.Analytic
